name: Paracetamol
uses: Fever and mild to moderate pain
side_effects: Rare at normal dose; nausea, rash; liver damage in overdose
precautions: Do not exceed the daily limit (max 4 g/day for adults); avoid with heavy alcohol use or liver disease
mechanism: Reduces prostaglandin synthesis in the brain to lower fever and pain

name: Ibuprofen
side_effects: Stomach upset, ulcers, raised blood pressure, kidney strain
precautions: Take with food; avoid in ulcers, kidney disease, late pregnancy; caution in heart disease
mechanism: Blocks COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes so less prostaglandin is made

name: Aspirin
uses: Pain, fever; low dose to prevent heart attack and stroke in selected patients
precautions: Avoid in children with viral illness (Reye's syndrome); caution with ulcers and blood thinners
mechanism: Irreversibly inhibits COX so platelets cannot clump easily

name: Metformin
side_effects: Nausea, diarrhoea, metallic taste; rarely lactic acidosis
precautions: Avoid in severe kidney impairment; stop before contrast scans; take with meals
mechanism: Reduces liver glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity

name: Amlodipine
precautions: Rise slowly from sitting; caution in severe liver disease
mechanism: Relaxes blood vessels by blocking calcium entry into smooth muscle

name: Atorvastatin
uses: High cholesterol; prevention of cardiovascular disease
side_effects: Muscle pain, raised liver enzymes, digestive upset
precautions: Avoid in pregnancy; report unexplained muscle pain; periodic liver tests
mechanism: Inhibits HMG-CoA reductase so the liver makes less cholesterol

name: Losartan
uses: Hypertension, diabetic kidney protection, heart failure
side_effects: Dizziness, high potassium, cough is rare
precautions: Avoid in pregnancy; monitor kidney function and potassium
mechanism: Blocks angiotensin II receptors causing blood vessels to relax

name: Metoprolol
uses: Hypertension, angina, arrhythmia, after heart attack
side_effects: Tiredness, slow heart rate, cold hands, dizziness
precautions: Do not stop suddenly; caution in asthma and diabetes
mechanism: Blocks beta-1 receptors to slow heart rate and lower BP

name: Amoxicillin
uses: Bacterial infections of ear throat chest and urinary tract
precautions: Avoid if allergic to penicillin; complete the full course
mechanism: Prevents bacteria from building their cell wall

name: Omeprazole
side_effects: Headache, stomach pain, long term low magnesium or B12
precautions: Take before food; long-term use only under medical advice
mechanism: Blocks the proton pump in stomach cells to reduce acid

name: Cetirizine
precautions: May cause sleepiness - avoid driving; reduce dose in kidney disease

name: Salbutamol
precautions: Seek help if needed more often than usual; caution in heart disease
mechanism: Relaxes airway muscles by stimulating beta-2 receptors
